card.tagline: Hungary — women's circle dance in 44 time
card.profile: The lánytánc is a Hungarian folk dance similar to the karikázó in that it is a women's circle dance in 44 time.  Unlike the karikázó, the dance is performed to instrumental rather than vocal music.
